_note: A small, standalone family: broad Insular Celtic, Goidelic-leaning (Gaelic) with a Brythonic sub-palette available. Only one clean member (Cuchulan); Celtic otherwise appears in CROSS-family blends authored with their partner families: Gundic (6+7 Germanic x Celtic), Shidhean (7+10 Celtic x Japanese), Senecar (7+16 Celtic x Woodland). Those blends should reflex their Celtic component from the theonym_set below. Base provides the concept inventory, morphology template, shared roots, the clanhold title structure, and the Celtic theonym morph-set. Orthography in the data is ASCII (the fada/long-mark is dropped: i for i-fada, etc.).

phonology.palette: Insular Celtic: initial consonant mutation (lenition c>ch, b>bh/v, m>mh/v, t>th, d>dh; nasalization); broad vs slender consonants; vowels a e i o u (long marks dropped in data); stress usually root-initial.

sub_palette_notes.goidelic: Gaelic (Irish/Scots): mac/ua patronymics; -an/-in diminutives; roots ri/tuath/dun/rath/cland/fine; the c/ch and broad-slender contrast.
sub_palette_notes.brythonic: Brittonic (Welsh/Cumbric): ap/ferch patronymics; -wy/-ydd/-og endings; roots brenin/teyrn/caer/llan/pen; p where Goidelic has c (Brythonic *pen vs Goidelic *cenn).

lexicon_concepts._note: Same concept inventory as the other family bases; realized per sub-palette in each culture kit.

shared_roots._note: Common Celtic cognates (common words and titles, allowed; theophoric built only on the morphed canon-forms below, never real Celtic gods).

theonym_set._note: Celtic morphs of the Agrippan canon: phoneme-morphs through Insular-Celtic phonology (lenition; -an/-id endings; v>b/f). These are NOT real Celtic gods. Cuchulan realizes them directly; cross-family Celtic blends (Gundic/Shidhean/Senecar) reflex their Celtic component from here. Distinct from the Celtiberian forms in culture_cantabran.json (which are Latinate-Celtic).

morphology_template.toponymic_suffixes: settlement = Dun-/Rath- (fort), Baile- (stead), Cill- (church/cell), Ard- (height), Mag- (plain); feature-compound common.
morphology_template.patronymic_form: Goidelic Mac- (son of) / O-Ua (descendant of); Brythonic ap-/ferch; kin-group = fine, wider clan = cland.

title_ladder_structure._note: ACKS 7 tiers, clanhold. Built on ri (king) and tuath (petty kingdom): ri-tuaithe (king of a tuath) at principality, ruiri (over-king) at kingdom, ard-ri (high king) at empire. The brithem (judge) and fili/ollam (poet-sage) stand outside the ladder. Tier->ruler-level mapping pending the ACKS lookup.

conventions.people_name_default: personal name + Mac-/O- patronymic or fine/cland; deed or animal epithet (the Hound, the Red) for the renowned; order given-first.
conventions.transparent_vs_opaque: moderate; many names are transparent compounds.
